Sous certaines publications du compte In: Under some posts of Onirique's Instagram account, you are invited to comment a word (for example "RISER") to receive a link. When you comment that word, Onirique's account automatically replies under your comment, then sends you the link in a private message, only once. This service goes through Instagram's official API (Meta): Onirique only receives what Meta passes on for those posts.
